learning_outcomes.text: Students expand their acquired knowledge in engineering education and subject didactics.
Students transfer their knowledge to didactic problems of designing educational and qualification processes.
Students assess the suitability of acquired knowledge for addressing didactic problems.

Students know and use project management instruments. They apply engineering education and subject didactic strategies and methods to analyze professional technical work and to design professional education and qualification processes in a problem-related manner.
Students are able to penetrate complex problems in engineering education and develop solutions.
Students develop solutions or solution approaches in a team/group and self-organized within a given time. They present their work results.
Students reflect on the state of their didactic professionalization.

syllabus_topics: Analysis of the task and definition of goals from a topic complex of engineering education
Creation of project and milestone plan
Developing and possibly carrying out possible solution concepts
Evaluation and reflection of selected solutions
assessment_rules: The graded examination performance is a written project report of 20-40 pages.
